name: Anas SENHAJI
bio: Anas SENHAJI is the Founder and Sport Media Manager of DeeplyAfrica, a Morocco-based digital sports media platform focused on African football coverage, competition analysis, visual storytelling and media operations.

name: DeeplyAfrica Editorial Desk
bio: The DeeplyAfrica Editorial Desk produces original coverage, match previews, football analysis and visual storytelling focused on African football.

name: Contributors Network
bio: DeeplyAfrica works with a growing network of football contributors, content producers and match analysts across Morocco and Africa.
